title: Packers Aaron Rodgers Is Dating Fellow Bucks Owner Wes Edens' Daughter Mallory Edens, Per Report
htmlContent:
Aaron Rodgers and Mallory Edens are seeing each other, according to TMZ Sports.

Aaron Rodgers seems to have a new woman in his life. The Green Bay Packers superstar goes out with Mallory Edens, the daughter of the owner of the Milwaukee Bucks.

The rumors of the new 4-time MVP romance started to rise this week. after the two were spotted sitting courtside together at the Bucks vs. Lakers game last month.

Rodgers is a minority owner of the Milwaukee NBA team… and he has appeared at Bucks with Eden in the past. However, things seemed platonic at the time, as the quarterback was dating actress Shailene Woodley.

As reports say, they are now an item. Edens also attended one of the Rodgers Packers games this season dressed in Green Bay gear.

Mallory is the daughter of Wes Edens, the billionaire businessman and co-owner of the Premier League club, Aston Villa. She is a model and social media personality.

Speaking of Mallory Edens, she made headlines back in 2019 when she trolled Raptors Super Fan Drake by wearing a Push T t-shirt.
